data.translation:
Investigators from the Directorate of General Crimes at the Criminal Investigation Agency of the Indonesian National Police have named six suspects in a case involving alleged treason, with a motive described by investigators as an attempt to keep the National Police chief in office for political gain by undermining public trust in President Prabowo Subianto’s administration.

Here are the details of the alleged roles of the six suspects and the legal framework applied:

1. Each Suspect’s Alleged Role.

* LSP: Suspected of ordering wiretapping and surveillance and receiving reports on their results from the other suspects.

* ASN: Suspected of drafting meeting directives to be passed on to SU, identifying targets and ordering wiretapping, receiving daily reports, instructing TK to conduct surveillance, ordering the recruitment of external parties and demonstrations on specific themes, arranging operational funding, and ordering the deletion of servers to eliminate traces.

* SU: Suspected of leading the initial conspiracy meeting, identifying targets, ordering Monitoring Center (MC) personnel to conduct wiretapping, and receiving daily wiretapping and surveillance reports.

* EH: Suspected of participating in the initial conspiracy meeting, identifying targets, and issuing wiretapping orders.

* TK: Suspected of attending the initial conspiracy meeting, conducting field surveillance at several locations/posts, receiving daily surveillance reports, and reporting them to AS.

* IM: Suspected of ordering the creation of content attacking others and ordering 500 T-shirts featuring a three-finger design to be worn during demonstrations.

2. Applicable Provisions & Criminal Penalties.

The suspects are suspected of conspiring, preparing for, and beginning to carry out treason with the intent to deprive the President of liberty, render the President incapable of governing, or overthrow the government, under Article 191, Article 193, and/or Article 196 of the Criminal Code, in conjunction with Article 160 of the Criminal Code, in conjunction with Article 20(a), (b), (c), and (d) of the Criminal Code, in conjunction with Law No. 1 of 2026 on the Adjustment of Criminal Offenses. The penalties include the death penalty, life imprisonment, or imprisonment for up to 20 years.

3. Detention Status & Access.

Suspects LSP, EH, and ASN have been detained by the Directorate of Cybercrime (after previously being handled in connection with illegal wiretapping), suspects TK and IM are still undergoing access/processing by the Indonesian National Police’s Professional and Security Division, while suspect SU has not been detained due to post-stroke health conditions. All descriptions of the alleged roles and charges remain within the scope of the investigation, upholding the presumption of innocence.

.

Penyidik Direktorat Tindak Pidana Umum Bareskrim Polri menetapkan enam tersangka dalam kasus dugaan tindak pidana makar dengan motif yang diuraikan penyidik sebagai upaya mempertahankan jabatan Kapolri demi kepentingan konstelasi politik, dengan cara melemahkan kepercayaan publik terhadap pemerintahan Presiden Prabowo Subianto.

Berikut rincian dugaan peran keenam tersangka dan konstruksi hukumnya :

1. Peran Masing-Masing Tersangka.

* LSP: Diduga memerintahkan serta menerima laporan hasil penyadapan dan surveillance dari tersangka lainnya.

* ​ASN: Diduga menyusun arahan poin rapat untuk diteruskan kepada SU, menentukan target & memerintahkan penyadapan, menerima laporan harian, menginstruksikan surveillance kepada TK, memerintahkan penggalangan pihak eksternal serta demonstrasi bertema tertentu, mengupayakan dana operasional, hingga memerintahkan penghapusan server untuk menghilangkan jejak.

* ​SU: Diduga memimpin rapat permufakatan awal, menentukan target, memerintahkan penyadapan kepada personel Monitoring Center (MC), serta menerima laporan harian penyadapan dan surveillance.

* EH: Diduga terlibat dalam rapat permufakatan awal, menentukan target, dan memberikan perintah penyadapan.

* ​TK: Diduga ikut rapat permufakatan awal, melakukan surveillance lapangan di sejumlah titik/pos, menerima laporan harian surveillance, dan melaporkannya kepada AS.

* IM: Diduga memerintahkan pembuatan konten menyerang serta memesan 500 kaus bermotif tiga jari untuk dipakai dalam aksi demonstrasi.

2. Jerat Pasal & Ancaman Pidana.

Para tersangka disangkakan melakukan permufakatan jahat, persiapan, hingga permulaan pelaksanaan makar dengan maksud merampas kemerdekaan Presiden, menjadikan Presiden tidak mampu menjalankan pemerintahan, atau menggulingkan pemerintah berdasarkan Pasal 191, Pasal 193, dan/atau Pasal 196 KUHP jo. Pasal 160 KUHP jo. Pasal 20 huruf a, b, c, dan d KUHP jo. UU No. 1 Tahun 2026 tentang Penyesuaian Tindak Pidana. Ancaman pidananya meliputi pidana mati, penjara seumur hidup, atau pidana penjara paling lama 20 tahun.

3. Status Penahanan & Akses.

Tersangka LSP, EH, dan ASN telah ditahan oleh Dittipidsiber (setelah sebelumnya ditangani terkait penyadapan ilegal), tersangka TK dan IM masih menjalani akses/proses oleh Divpropam Polri, sedangkan tersangka SU tidak dilakukan penahanan karena kondisi kesehatan pascastroke. Seluruh uraian peran dan sangkaan tersebut tetap berada dalam koridor penyidikan dengan menjunjung asas praduga tak bersalah.

result.text:
REVOLUSI YANG SUDAH BERJALAN, TAPI TIDAK DIKENALI

Di hadapan ribuan kader Muhammadiyah, dalam pembukaan Tanwir dan Milad ke-114 Muhammadiyah, Presiden Prabowo Subianto mengucapkan kalimat yang langsung jadi headline di semua media:

"Yang bisa bikin revolusi di Indonesia adalah Prabowo Subianto. Petani di belakang saya, nelayan di belakang saya."

Banyak orang menertawakan kalimat itu. Banyak yang bilang: "Ah, Prabowo sombong. Prabowo haus kekuasaan. Prabowo mau jadi diktator."

Padahal, kalau kita dengar pidato itu sampai selesai — bukan hanya potongan 15 detik di TikTok — maknanya justru terbalik.

Prabowo tidak sedang mengumumkan akan membuat revolusi. Ia sedang mengatakan: Revolusi itu sudah saya mulai. Dan saya tidak akan mundur, walaupun digoyang.

Ini kalimat lengkapnya: "Sumpah saya hidup jiwa raga saya untuk rakyat, untuk bangsa Indonesia. Di usia saya pensiun, saya harus melihat rakyat saya masih miskin. Saya harus melihat kekayaan kita diambil terus." 

"Disangka saya gentar? Saya tidak akan gentar. Saya letnan, nggak punya apa-apa. Sudah siap mati, apalagi sekarang Muhammadiyah di belakang saya, NU, Muhammadiyah, Persis di belakang saya." 

"Yang dikerjakan oleh pembantu-pembantu saya semua ini, yang kita kerjakan adalah bagaimana kita memperbaiki sistem yang keliru di Indonesia supaya bisa dinikmati oleh seluruh rakyat Indonesia." 

Jadi, revolusi yang dimaksud Prabowo bukan revolusi dengan senjata. Bukan revolusi dengan membakar gedung. Bukan revolusi dengan mengganti UUD.

Revolusi yang dimaksud adalah memperbaiki sistem yang keliru — sistem yang membuat kekayaan Indonesia diambil terus, sementara rakyatnya tetap miskin. Dan sistem yang keliru itu, kalau kita jujur, ada di dua tempat: *di ekonomi, dan di politik.

REVOLUSI PERTAMA: REVOLUSI EKONOMI — INI YANG SUDAH JALAN

Inilah yang paling tidak disadari banyak orang. Saat ini, di tengah masyarakat ada segolongan yang hidupkan kembali gagasan kembali ke UUD 1945 yang asli, dengan mendorong Presiden Prabowo untuk melakukan revolusi konstitusi.

Mereka menunggu Prabowo mengubah teks UUD. Mereka menunggu sidang MPR. Mereka menunggu amandemen dibatalkan.

Padahal, Prabowo sudah melakukan revolusi yang jauh lebih dalam: *Ia tidak mengubah teksnya. Ia mengubah pelaksanaannya.*

Karena selama ini, masalah kita bukan teks UUD 1945 yang salah. Masalah kita adalah teks UUD 1945 yang tidak pernah dijalankan.

Coba buka Pasal 33 UUD 1945: Ayat (1): Perekonomian disusun sebagai usaha bersama berdasar atas asas kekeluargaan

Ayat (2): Cabang-cabang produksi yang penting bagi negara dan yang menguasai hajat hidup orang banyak dikuasai oleh negara.

Ayat (3): Bumi dan air dan kekayaan alam yang terkandung di dalamnya dikuasai oleh negara dan dipergunakan untuk sebesar-besar kemakmuran rakyat.

Lalu Pasal 34: Fakir miskin dan anak-anak yang terlantar dipelihara oleh negara. Selama 26 tahun reformasi, pasal-pasal ini seperti pajangan di dinding. Dihafal anak SD, tapi tidak pernah jadi pedoman APBN.

Apa yang dilakukan Prabowo dalam dua tahun ini? Ia merevolusi pasal-pasal yang dipinggirkan itu menjadi prioritas, dan anggarannya dibesarkan.

Buktinya paling nyata ada di tiga hal: pertama, Makan Bergizi Gratis, Sekolah Rakyat, Cek Kesehatan Gratis — Ini Pasal 34 yang Hidup

Dulu, Pasal 34 hanya berarti "negara memberi bansos". Sekarang, Pasal 34 berarti negara hadir dari perut sampai ke sekolah.

Makan Bergizi Gratis bukan sekadar bagi-bagi makanan. Ia adalah cara negara mengatakan: "Anak miskin tidak boleh lapar saat belajar."

Sekolah Rakyat bukan sekadar sekolah baru. Ia adalah cara negara mengatakan: "Anak miskin tidak boleh putus sekolah karena tidak punya biaya." Itu Pasal 34 yang selama ini tidur, sekarang dibangunkan.

Kedua, Danantara — Ini Revolusi Pasal 33 Ayat (4). Inilah yang paling revolusioner, dan paling tidak dipahami.

1. CRIMES AGAINST THE CONSTITUTION CONSTITUTIONAL COURT RULING 90

Bro, this is the most damning one.

Reformasi was born because we no longer wanted a president who could mess with the constitution however he pleased, like the New Order and the serial-marrying order.

But during the Jokowi era, the constitution was changed not through the MPR, not through a referendum, but through CONSTITUTIONAL COURT RULING No. 90/PUU-XXI/2023.

A ruling that changed the age requirements for presidential and vice-presidential candidates, paving the way for Gibran, his son, to become vice president at 36. Isn't that insane? After failing to extend the term of office and get a third term, he instead put his kids in an adult game.

And who was the Chief Justice of the Constitutional Court at the time? Anwar Usman. Who is Anwar Usman? Jokowi's brother-in-law. Gibran's uncle.

Bro, this is no longer a conspiracy theory. This is a FACT already ruled on by the Constitutional Court Honor Council (MKMK). The MKMK said Anwar Usman was proven to have committed serious ethical violations and removed him as Chief Justice.

Rocky says: This is the most perfectly executed constitutional crime. Because the crime wasn't committed with a weapon, but with a judge's gavel.

In other reformasi eras, some people were corrupt, some engaged in collusion. But no one dared to change the constitution for their own child. Only during the Jokowi era. Once again, bro, ONLY DURING THE JOKOWI ERA.

2. CRIMES AGAINST DEMOCRACY MEDDLING AND DYNASTY

Bro, Jokowi was elected by the people twice. 2014 and 2019. The people were DUPED by image-building tricks into believing he was a good person, a guy from Solo, a man of the people. When in fact he's also a kind of Pol Pot, just as brutal.

ARE PEOPLE REALLY THAT STUPID?

When the National Police Chief declared before the honorable assembly that Listyo Sigit Prabowo is the end user, or final recipient, of this mass wiretapping scandal, the public is not being offered law enforcement, but a bland constitutional farce.

Let's use common sense and stop letting our logic be trampled on.
Legally, structurally, and by the very nature of intelligence work anywhere in the world, a police chief or intelligence agency chief is merely an operator, a courier, and a collector of information.

Their job is to present fully processed data to the highest-level policymakers. And now we're being forced to believe that a National Police Chief wiretapped the President, ministers, politicians, businesspeople, and even activists just for his own personal consumption?
Just so he could read it himself while drinking coffee in his office?
Do you think people are stupid?!

The claim that the former National Police Chief is the end of this information chain is a blatant attempt to deceive the public. Saying that Listyo Sigit is the end user is tantamount to cutting corners in the pursuit of truth to protect the "real boss" who is actually behind the scenes.

A massive, systematic wiretapping scandal that uses state defense equipment and targets the heart of power could not possibly have proceeded without high-level political orders. There are enormous interests at stake in protecting a dynasty, mapping out opponents' strengths, and steering the nation's political direction.

If the police only dare to stop at the operator level and are afraid to identify who actually placed the orders, then the law in this country is nothing more than a charade.

Don't dress up the fear of investigating the "real rulers" in a false narrative that insults people's intelligence.
People have been awake for a long time. We can no longer be fed lies! Expose the mastermind, or just admit that justice in this country is indeed selective!

Is the real End User Jokowi‼️

Executive Director of Amnesty International Indonesia, Usman Hamid, has indeed urged the police (the National Police Criminal Investigation Department) to question or investigate Indonesia's 7th President, Joko Widodo (Jokowi).

Here are the key points of Usman Hamid's argument:
• The Concept of the Intelligence End User: Usman explains that, within the constitutional system, intelligence agencies (such as the National Police, BIN, and the Indonesian Military's BAIS) collect information to hand over to the end user, namely the Head of State. Since this alleged illegal wiretapping scandal has implicated former National Police Chief General Listyo Sigit Prabowo, the investigation is considered incomplete unless it examines who ordered or received the data.
• Jokowi's 2023 Statement: Usman links this call to something Jokowi said in late 2023. At the time, Jokowi, who was still serving as President, openly admitted to holding intelligence data on political parties and their political direction. Usman believes that if that data was used not to address threats to the country's sovereignty but for political purposes, it constitutes a serious abuse of power.
• Developing the Case's Theory of Motive: According to Usman, the motive behind the wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto, along with several public figures, activists, and businesspeople, is most likely not singular (not merely an alleged coup plot), but is connected to building a network of power to secure certain political interests.
Meanwhile, in response to his name being dragged into this case involving the former National Police Chief, Joko Widodo briefly stated that everyone should follow the ongoing legal process
